meta.title: اختبار الفصل الأول في اللغة الإنجليزية (النموذج 4)
topics: places in town: bakery, post office, library
prepositions of place: next to, opposite, between

paper:
Hi! My name is Lina. I live in a small town near the sea. In my town, there is a big park, a hospital and a post office. The bakery is next to my house. My school is opposite the mosque. The library is between the post office and the park. On Fridays, I go to the park with my brother. I love my town!

(Text written by the site)

Exercise 1 (3 pts)

Read and answer True or False:

  1. Lina lives in a big city.
  2. The bakery is next to Lina's house.
  3. Lina's school is opposite the hospital.

Exercise 2 (2 pts)

  1. Where is the library?
  2. When does Lina go to the park?

Exercise 3 (2 pts)

Match each place with what you do there:

bakerysee a doctor
hospitalread books
post officebuy bread
librarysend a letter

Written expression (3 pts)

Write three sentences about your town. Use there is / there are and next to / opposite.
